$sources: Classical: every work of data/classical.json is a plaster cast of the Royal Cast Collection, SMK (assets/classical/CREDITS.md: 3D scans of plaster casts), shown as the cast: plaster of Paris cast in piece moulds, its seams kept, sized (Data/Matter/Palette.json white.plaster-of-paris, whose roles are the Classical Hall's 41 casts and the Rotunda's four).

Degas: data/sculptures.json's dancer is the wax, with 'bronzes posthumous, from 1922', and asks to label the bronzes as posthumous casts; the Salon shows a bronze (its Hang.json entry, and the collection's scan is the Metropolitan Museum's bronze, assets/sculptures/CREDITS.md), a century indoors under its patina (Palette.json bronze.cusn10 patinated, aged.patina).

Chenghuai's ceramics (assets/collection.json media), each in its glaze over its body, clean in its case: the Ding basin's ivory glaze over porcelain; the Jun flowerpot's, the Guan vase's, the Jian bowl's (hare's fur, a dark iron glaze) and the Longquan vase's (celadon) over stoneware (Palette.json accent.porcelain-glazed and accent.stoneware-glazed).

The vessels derived from their own photographs (Data/Art/Ceramics.json media, Data/Art/Vessels.json): the peach-bloom vase in its copper glaze over porcelain (accent.porcelain-glazed glazed.peach-bloom), the Ru basin in its celadon over a buff stoneware (accent.stoneware-glazed glazed.ru); the painted porcelains in accent.porcelain-painted, painted in cobalt under the glaze (the Xuande jar, the meiping) or in enamels over it (the wucai jar, the chicken cup, the falangcai bowl), each wearing its own decoration, composed from its photographs, over that finish.
